caption: Today: the panel from the front page's Settings, on althar with Linear found in its tasks' issues, all connected, 9 notes
Today without a tracker: no way to add one; Repositories goes across and the switches move to fill the grid
Today with Linear not connected: only a small grey Connect beside its name says so
Today with tasks naming Linear and Jira issues: the panel shows only the first tracker
Today: Notes opened, in place of the grid
Every direction's bar: Home (was Both) on the left, then Conversation, Board and Settings; the front page has no Settings button of its own
With GitHub signed out, Settings in the bar carries the violet needs-you dot, and the front page lists signing in again
A, General at 1180×760: no switch cards down the side any more; the three switches under “How its tasks work”, each saying what happens with it on and with it off
A, Code and issues in the smaller window: Repositories and Trackers as two headings with their own Add buttons, Linear's mark plain; Move issues is in General now, not here
A, Code and issues with Linear not connected and Jira added: the violet line and Connect on Linear's row, the dot on the section and on Settings
A, Running: unchanged, what it runs and where its work goes
A, Notes as cards: each decision set as words to read, who kept it and when under it, newest first; the cross to drop one shows on hover
A, Notes in the smaller window: the cards fall to two columns
A, General on a project with no tracker: Move issues is off and greyed, its note says to add a tracker first, with a link
B, tabs, under the project's own header: its sections as tabs with the switches beside them, General as wide as the page
B, Code and issues with Linear and Jira named and Linear not connected: the tab carries the violet dot
B, Rules: the rules screen page-wide under the tabs
C, one page under the project's own header: every section after another, each part labelled down the left as the rules' clauses are; the jump bar held on top
C, scrolled to Code and issues on a project with no tracker: the Trackers clause offers to add one
C, scrolled to Running and Notes, Remove at the very end
D, overview under the project's own header: a card per section saying what it holds now, the switches in their cards; Remove a quiet button at the foot
D, overview with GitHub signed out and two trackers: the Code card says a connection needs you, its row says what to do
D, a card opened: Code and issues on a page of its own, the overview a crumb away
